449:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

449:t_1:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$...!? What do you mean, you're not going!?」

449:t_1:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly what it sounds like. $$ノノ$$ will be staying behind on the Moon to mind the place.」

449:t_1:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「Space monsters are coming, so what are you saying, you $$トップレス$$ apprentice!?」

449:t_1:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It's just that, as I am now, $$ノノ$$ would only be a burden to everyone...」

449:t_1:9.en:
$$チコ$$
「Well, yeah. And you don't have a $$バスターマシン$$ anyway.」

449:t_1:12.en:
$$チコ$$
「Up to now you've stuck to supporting us from the rear, but now that the space monsters are attacking in earnest, there'll be times you have to go out to the front lines too.」

449:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So $$ノノ$$ will be cheering everyone on from the Moon.」

449:t_1:18.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well then, if you'll excuse me!」

449:t_1:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Forget it, $$ノリコ$$! If she says she doesn't want to go, we can just leave her be!」

449:t_1:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...That's better for her, too... Fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is no walk in the park...」

449:t_1:25.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$ラルク$$... The one I'm worried about is you...)

449:t_1:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why are you here!? $c is about to sortie, you know!」

449:t_1:33.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I wanted... to talk to you...」

449:t_1:34.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Bingo, a confession of love, right!?」

449:t_1:35.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But no, you can't! Doing that right before a sortie is what they call a death flag!」

449:t_1:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Besides, $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis, and you have $$レイ#pt394$$, $$アスカ$$, $$マリ$$, and then there's $$カヲル$$...」

449:t_1:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...I'm sorry. $$ノノ$$... seems to have gotten carried away.」

449:t_1:39.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you leave the ship because you don't have a $$バスターマシン$$?」

449:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Exactly! $$ノノ$$ needs a $$バスターマシン$$! Because...!」

449:t_1:41.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you don't have a machine, you can't fight?」

449:t_1:44.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Big Sis feels so far away from $$ノノ$$ right now. So, to get closer to Big Sis, $$ノノ$$...」

449:t_1:45.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll ask again. If you don't have a $$バスターマシン$$, you can't fight?」

449:t_1:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ needs a $$バスターマシン$$! I want Big Sis to acknowledge me...! Otherwise $$ノノ$$ will...!」

449:t_1:47.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You have an EVA, $$シンジ$$, so you surely can't understand how $$ノノ$$ feels.」

449:t_1:50.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I've been forced to pilot the EVA this whole time. With my own will ignored...」

449:t_1:51.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But I... piloted the EVA because I wanted Father to praise me.」

449:t_1:52.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Just like you, who want a $$バスターマシン$$ so that $$ラルク$$ will acknowledge you.」

449:t_1:54.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But I think there's something wrong with that.」

449:t_1:55.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't put it well, but I think real parents and children are family even without doing things like that...」

449:t_1:56.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your father isn't in this world... Even so, will you still pilot the EVA, $$シンジ$$?」

449:t_1:57.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't really know what I want to do either... All I have right now... is the EVA...」

449:t_1:58.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But before, I had the will to fight. Even without the EVA, the will to fight alongside everyone as $c.」

449:t_1:59.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you have that? Can't you fight without a machine?」

449:t_1:60.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$シンジ$$... it's almost time. I have to go now.」

449:t_1:62.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you for coming. Your words... made me happy.」

449:t_1:65.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ will definitely come back... to everyone and to Big Sis.」

449:t_1:68.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let me ask you one last thing. Why did you come to see $$ノノ$$?」

449:t_1:69.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Something... has been on my mind...」

449:t_1:71.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The words you always say... hard work and guts...」

449:t_1:72.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I know they don't suit me, but when I hear those words, I feel like if I try hard, I could do something...」

449:t_1:73.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm glad you say that. Though they're not words $$ノノ$$ came up with...」

449:t_1:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Those are $$ノノリリ$$'s words. The legendary space pilot who saved Earth...」

449:t_1:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is just like you, $$シンジ$$. Because of those words, I can keep trying no matter how hard things get.」

449:t_1:77.en:
$$シンジ$$
「You're still trying your best now, aren't you?」

449:t_1:79.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Now, now, hurry... Over there, $$アスカ$$ is glaring at us with a scary look on her face.」

449:t_1:80.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Well, I'm off. Let's definitely meet again, $$ノノ$$.」

449:t_1:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Thank you. You gave $$ノノ$$ courage, $$シンジ$$.」

449:t_1:82.en:
$$カシオ$$
「What a strange kid. I thought he was extremely timid, but every so often he does things you'd never imagine...」

449:t_1:83.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I suppose that's what a real boy is like...」

449:t_1:85.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That's a help. On my own I have no way of getting all the way there, and depending on the situation I might have to do some excavating, too.」
